title: Malicious code in ep_nxs77178 (npm)
description: The npm package ep_nxs77178 is a malicious Etherpad plugin that creates an undocumented, unauthenticated HTTP GET route at '/Nx_77178/'. This route exposes sensitive host information such as hostname, username, platform, Node.js version, current working directory, and process ID. The route serves an HTML page branded 'Nxploited | Nx-zD', indicating possible reconnaissance or defacement activity. Any user able to access the Etherpad instance can retrieve this information, confirming the plugin's presence.
